parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-11 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 82.6 | 5.04 | 5.04
2 | 162.4 | 1.62 | 6.66
3 | 121.3 | 2.57 | 9.23
4 | 152.0 | 0.91 | 10.14
5 | 105.9 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

**Station:** T-11
**Curve type:** KHK (five-layer curve: ρ1<ρ2>ρ3<ρ4>ρ5)
**Aquifer depth:** below 10.14 m (Layer 5, ρ = 105.9 ohm-m, inferred saturated zone)
**Recommendation:** Drill past 10.14 m to fully penetrate the lower-resistivity basal layer, which is interpreted as the main water-bearing unit; set screens in this zone and confirm lithology/water strike with drill cuttings during advance.
